q.q: Which page replacement algorithm can exhibit Belady's anomaly (more frames leading to more page faults)?
q.x: FIFO is the only algorithm among these that can suffer from Belady's anomaly. LRU and Optimal never do.

q.q: A situation in which the system spends more time swapping pages in and out than executing is called:
q.x: Thrashing occurs when excessive paging leaves little time for actual execution.
